text: right ive been sat waiting on this line for the best part of an hour so im just going to put it all in here and hope somebody actually reads it its my granddaughter shes 15 months old and im looking after her tonight her temperature is 39.3 i took it twice to be sure and its 39.3 both times she went up hot sometime yesterday afternoon so its not been long her eczema is flaring up again dry itchy patches on her arms and behind her knees and shes been scratching at them which i think is just the eczema but i dont know if the temperature makes it worse or what she was sick once earlier this evening just the once mind and since then shes had her drinks and kept them all down no bother so i think thats alright her colour is normal i checked her lips and her skin and theyre the same as always not pale or anything and because of all the red bits from the eczema i did that glass thing my daughter told me about pressed a glass on them and they went white and faded so i think thats ok but im not sure im not a doctor am i i just want somebody to tell me if 39.3 is too high for a baby that age or if i keep going with what im doing because the leaflet says one thing and the internet says another and frankly id like a straight answer from somebody who knows
